source_review: No unresolved source findings after the generated-condition fix and preservation of ordinary aggregate functions.

review.public_types: Public aggregate functions remain ordinary, first-class functions with unchanged argument/result types. Three thin wrappers invoke fused typed intrinsics; shapes are checked before descriptor allocation. No unchecked key/proof option is exposed.
review.points: Every untrusted point reaches canonical, curve and prime-order subgroup decoding. Signature/key identities remain rejected. Hash-to-curve points are generated internally and stay decoded.
review.ic_distinctness: Pairwise exact Blob equality is preserved; larger batches sort bounded indices using a length-then-byte total order. Duplicate messages are rejected before signature validation.
review.proof_cache: Only an exact key/proof byte pair already verified successfully earlier in this synchronous call can reuse its decoded key. Different proofs for repeated keys are checked; no retained cache exists.
review.ethereum_messages: Only messages of at most 1024 bytes may reuse an earlier same-call hash; equality compares exact bytes, and all PoPs are checked before constructing aggregate terms.
review.error_order: IC: shapes/limits, duplicate messages, signature then keys. General Ethereum: shapes/limits, signature then all proofs. Fast Ethereum: shapes/limits, all proofs, signature decoding, aggregate-key/signature identity. Both operands of an individual PoP decode before identity checks.
review.domains: IC NUL, Ethereum POP signature and Ethereum POP proof DSTs are unchanged; APIs still accept raw protocol-framed messages, with framing performed by callers.
review.gc_and_lifetimes: Compiler-owned Blob/Array helpers resolve forwarding. Descriptor and payload raw pointers are borrowed only within the generated synchronous operation; SDK allocation has no GC safepoint. Runtime stores no native state. Temporary Rust Vec allocations use ephemeral managed Blob scratch reclaimed by later GC.
review.bounds: Compiler and runtime bound general aggregates to 127 and fast aggregates to 128. Descriptor rows are 48 bytes on the memory64 target, at most 6144 bytes; native input descriptors are a bounded 128-element stack array. Final general pairing has at most 128 terms. Message bytes are borrowed, never duplicated by the bridge.
review.pairing: The extracted pairing_product helper receives only decoded/subgroup-checked points or internal hash-to-curve results. Existing validated bilinear consolidation is unchanged. No malformed input is removed before validation.
review.source_simplification: Public Motoko wrapper packing, repeated point decompression, and intermediate hash compression are removed without weakening validation.

corrections.issue: README claimed a merge sort after moving to index sort_unstable.
corrections.resolution: Owner changed wording to bounded index sort.

corrections.issue: README claimed removal of raw-message packing, though old wrapper packed intermediate compressed points.
corrections.resolution: Owner corrected to packing/re-decoding intermediate points.

corrections.issue: Raw i64.compare instructions produce i32 conditions, but SDK B.E.if1 expects its 64-bit condition representation. Both array shape and count-limit checks generated invalid Wasm.
corrections.resolution: Owner used B.compile_comparison for both raw comparisons and rebuilt; the full native/interpreter/validated-memory64-Wasm suite now passes.

corrections.issue: Aliases changed three previously ordinary aggregate functions to intrinsic controls, preventing use as typed callbacks.
corrections.resolution: Owner restored three thin ordinary public wrappers around fused intrinsics. All21 audit commands pass, including typed record and higher-order callback tests on both backends.

limitations: Functional and source audit, not formal verification or empirical side-channel certification.
Fixed-input fresh-canister instruction/allocation measurements, not wall-time saturation testing.
Occupied-heap snapshots are neither peak nor live memory; all reclamation counters remain zero.

initial_test_fixture_corrections.issue: The n=2 duplicate generator accidentally assigned the last entry to itself.
initial_test_fixture_corrections.resolution: Use unique earlier positions; 246 native cases plus8bounds and270public cases remain.

initial_test_fixture_corrections.issue: Generated Motoko test used record-literal position braces for a statement block.

regressions: IC duplicate rejection n2: 1896 to 7891 instructions and 216 extra allocated bytes.
IC duplicate rejection n8: 8175 to 10886 instructions and 504 extra allocated bytes.
IC duplicate rejection n127: 4096 extra allocated bytes despite 2.13% fewer instructions.
Raw pairing instructions increase 19/28; single-verifier instruction counts and allocations are unchanged.
performance_review.assessment: Valid aggregate gains justify promotion while publishing invalid-input and code-size costs explicitly.
